caption: The drawing is on a round plate with a wide border densely decorated with overlapping flowers and leaves in a variety of sizes, all rendered in a uniform dark tone that contrasts with lighter sections of the plate. The central illustration on the plate depicts an outdoor river or canal scene in grayscale. In the foreground, there are four human figures, two appearing to stand together while the other two are spaced apart, with one possibly holding a stick. The ground beneath them appears rocky and textured. Behind them flows a body of water, crossed by a large stone bridge with three arches, and above the bridge, there are multiple buildings with peaked roofs. Several trees, including a line of tall, slender evergreens, are visible in the background, and rolling hills or mountains rise behind the trees and buildings. Above the scene, clouds are visible. In the lower central portion of the plate, text reads: "ERIE CANAL VIEW OF THE AQUEDUCT BRIDGE AT LITTLE FALLS." The entire composition is monochromatic, most likely rendered in shades of gray for a black-and-white image.
title: Plate - "Erie Canal"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
